description: This bar chart illustrates performance gain, measured as a percentage, for two language models—Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two supervision types: strong and weak. The horizontal axis displays the model names, labeled “Claude-3.5-Sonnet” and “Qwen2-72B-VL” in that order, while the vertical axis represents “Performance Gain (+%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. For each model, there are two bars representing the performance gain under different supervision types; bars with diagonal stripes represent “Strong Supervision” and solid lavender bars represent “Weak Supervision”. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 24%, while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 6%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 12%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 5%. The bars are arranged in pairs, one for each supervision type, adjacent to each model name, and are not sorted in any apparent order. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
